items.title: Frontend Developer
items.description: Building high-impact web solutions for global brands and first-tier institutions — Mahou, Greenpeace, Corona, Budweiser and Oxfam — delivering interfaces aligned with the highest quality and branding standards.
highlights: Modular, scalable frontend architectures with React and JavaScript (ES6+): clean, reusable components that cut delivery time on new features.
Interactive and 3D experiences with GSAP, Three.js and Framer Motion, raising visual engagement and user retention on promotional sites.
Custom WordPress themes and dynamic deployments through Timber and Twig, decoupling the presentation layer from CMS logic.
Continuous Core Web Vitals work: refactoring, asset strategy and mobile-first layout for better load times, a11y and SEO.
Agile collaboration: precise Figma-to-code handoff with UI/UX designers and PHP/MySQL backend sync for APIs and dynamic data.

items.title: Web Applications Developer
items.description: Development of functional, scalable web applications alongside the web development programme.
highlights: Built functional and scalable web applications from the ground up.
Designed and optimised user interfaces centred on experience and usability.

items.title: Logistics & Operations Planner
items.description: Delivery planning and stock management across a high-volume retail operation — the analytical groundwork behind a systematic approach to engineering.
highlights: Sales report analysis and product supervision.

items.title: Service Store Manager
items.description: Ran telecommunications service stores end to end, developing the user-centric problem solving that now informs interface design.

items.title: Commercial Supervisor
items.description: Supervised the commercial network and supported the sales force in the food channel, coordinating operations across logistics and marketing.
highlights: Commercial network supervision and sales-force support in the food channel.
Client relationship management, order control and delivery tracking.
Promotion coordination, point-of-sale strategy and results analysis.
Collaboration with logistics and marketing to optimise distribution and product visibility.
